title: How Super El Niño Is Turbocharging Weather Disasters
title_cn: 超级厄尔尼诺现象如何加剧天气灾害
summary: This year’s Super El Niño is already taking a heavy toll. From erratic rains in India to intense heat in Europe, weather extremes are threatening crops, supply chains, energy sources — and human life. As the world grapples with ever-increasing temperatures tied to global warming, this year may be a preview of how bad it will get in the not-too-distant future. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Eyes Iran Economic Squeeze | Radio Balance of Power: Early Edition 8/13/2026

summary: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the latest from the Middle East. On today's show, former Republican Congressman Patrick McHenry, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and CIBC Private Wealth Senior Energy Trader Rebecca Babin. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Wants to Expand Executive Privilege
title_cn: 特朗普希望扩大行政特权
summary: The Trump administration’s latest assertions about executive privilege — that it protects the privacy of a president’s communication with private advisers who aren’t part of the government — are like too much else in this White House: politically unprecedented, legally wrong and morally dubious, says Bloomberg Opinion columnist and Harvard Law Professor Noah Feldman. (Source: Bloomberg)
